New version debuts!

28 Oct 2025

Today I start to use a brand new version of my acedamic homepage! Excited.

The excellence of this version: 1) multiple pages, 2) nice layout design, 3) a personal logo, 4) my beloved color theme.

I wrote it myself by Jekyll. For that, I have particularly spent a little bit time (not that little,,) to learn how to use Jekyll to build a website (and even learn a little bit Ruby,, my Zig-Zag life…).

I feel like I was keeping dreaming of a fantastic acedamic homepage in those past years, but, just dreaming. Instead, I was keeping using a simple unfantastic one, which was initially created at the end of my postgraduate life. Actually at that time, like all of a sudden, my group’s members raised a hot wave of building personal academic homepage. Almost everyone in the lab was enthusiastic in writing his html codes, lasting for about two or three weeks. I also got excited by the wave. But I only came up with a quite simple version as a first step. Anyway, I quite enjoyed those days (that’s why I put down these memories here).
